note: Each mutant edits one definition or statement of lean/VE/Defaults/Meaning.lean (Lean, the only product language this item changes). Meaning.lean has no #guard: every definition is a Prop or is read by the theorems, so each mutant keeps every theorem and must fail inside each theorem it names ('theorems'); the fixtures file is only the joined file's tail and its guards are the control. kind: plan (DF-2's two seeded bugs), R16 (at least one per new trusted definition of tools/trust_map.py: withOpen, SwitchesOff, DefaultBase, softX, leastDecisions, replacementSafe, ReplacementHolds).
